title: Quaint Citrusy Slovakian Pork Toast
description: A citrusy Slovakian dish featuring pork, white flour, and toast, perfect for a date night, and is onion and garlic free. This recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Dip each slice of pork into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Dip the floured pork slices into the beaten eggs, making sure they are fully coated.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the pork slices until browned on both sides.
Transfer the pork slices to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
Toast the white bread slices until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of lemon juice and orange zest on each toast slice.
Top each toast slice with a slice of pork and serve immediately.
